title: Unambiguous sortie short IDs
goal: A short ID names one sortie, or the lookup says it is ambiguous
acceptance: A committed test with two colliding sorties fails before the fix
The F-042 test no longer depends on random UUID prefixes
escalation: A change to how the owner refers to sorties goes to a fresh-context review

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-13: a collision check and one regression. Not a measurement.
